title: PatentDataPrefill
description: Schema for prefilling patent application data.

contactReference.description: Contact reference. Used as contact information in some submitter scenarios.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Contact phone number. Used as contact information in some submitter scenarios.

inquiryMessage.description: Optional message or inquiry related to the application

inventionTitle.description: Title of the invention. Required when pctApplicationNumber is provided.

numberOfClaims.description: Number of claims in the patent application

acceleratedApplication.description: Whether this is an accelerated application

applicantPerformsMoreThan20ManYears.description: Whether the applicant performs more than 20 man-years

pctApplicationNumber.description: PCT (Patent Cooperation Treaty) application number. When provided, pctApplicationDate and inventionTitle are required.

pctApplicationDate.description: Date of the PCT application (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD). Required when pctApplicationNumber is provided.

dividedOrDivisional.description: Application type indicator. When set, divApplicationNumber and divApplicationDate are required.

divApplicationNumber.description: Application number for the divided or divisional application. Required when dividedOrDivisional is set.

divApplicationDate.description: Date of the divided or divisional application (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD). Required when dividedOrDivisional is set.

preliminarySearchReferenceNumber.description: Reference number for the preliminary search

earlierApplications.description: List of earlier applications claiming priority

agentOrApplicant.description: Whether the request is submitted as an agent or as the applicant.

agentCustomerNumber.description: Customer number for the agent. Optional. If omitted, it may be retrieved automatically for known customers. Must contain only digits when provided.

reasonApplicantNotSameAsInventor.description: Reason why applicant is not the same as inventor.

reasonApplicantNotSameAsInventorOtherExp.description: Free-text explanation. Required when reasonApplicantNotSameAsInventor is 'other'. Must be omitted for any other value.

applicantsAndInventors.description: List of applicants and inventors associated with the patent. Valid combinations are role=applicant with personOrOrganization=person or org, and role=inventor or both with personOrOrganization=person only.

submitter.description: Optional submitter identity. Used to populate requestor details in some submitter scenarios.

PrefillEarlierApplication.description: Represents an earlier application for priority claims

priorityDate.description: Priority date of the earlier application (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

country.description: Priority country or authority code. Use the returned value from the priorityCountries options endpoint; labels are display text only. The list may include authorities such as WIPO in addition to countries.

caseId.description: Case ID of the earlier application

PrefillApplicantOrInventor.description: Represents an applicant or inventor in the patent application. role + personOrOrganization together determine the valid contract shape.

role.description: Role in the application. 'applicant' may be used with person or org. 'inventor' and 'both' are valid only together with personOrOrganization='person'.

personOrOrganization.description: Entity type. 'person' requires firstName, lastName, and country. 'org' requires companyName and country, and also companyNumber when country is 'NO'. 'org' is invalid when role is 'inventor' or 'both'.

firstName.description: First name. Required when personOrOrganization is 'person'.

lastName.description: Last name. Required when personOrOrganization is 'person'.

companyName.description: Company name. Required when personOrOrganization is 'org'.

companyNumber.description: Organization number. Required when personOrOrganization is 'org' and country is 'NO'. Must contain only digits when provided.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO yyyy-MM-dd format. Optional in this schema. May be required for Norwegian persons.

country.description: Country code. Use the returned value from the countries options endpoint in Swagger; labels are display text only.

PrefillSubmitter.description: Optional submitter identity. Provide either firstName + lastName or companyName, together with streetAddress, postalCode, city, and country.

firstName.description: First name. Used together with lastName for person submitters.

lastName.description: Last name. Used together with firstName for person submitters.

companyName.description: Company name. Alternative to firstName + lastName for organization submitters.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO yyyy-MM-dd format. Optional in this schema. May be required for Norwegian person submitters.

country.description: Country code. Use the returned value from the countries options endpoint in Swagger; labels are display text only.
